title: Certificate in AI & Agentic AI for Finance
summary: Apply AI to finance operations including reconciliation support, research assistance, reporting, monitoring, and model-risk controls.
capstone: Finance operations agent on synthetic data with an audit trail and model-risk memo.
delivery: Self-paced draft modules with proposed weekend workshops, peer discussion and office hours; no cohort scheduled.
outcomes: O1: Map decision boundaries and evidence requirements for a synthetic reconciliation desk.
O2: Construct and explain a bounded prototype for a synthetic reconciliation desk.
O3: Evaluate ordinary, ambiguous and adversarial cases against a baseline.
O4: Demonstrate privacy minimization, human approval and recoverable failure.
O5: Defend a finance operations support portfolio with reproducible evidence and limitations.

modules.title: Define the decision boundary
modules.lesson: An assistant can suggest an action without permission to perform it. Name the decision owner, allowed inputs, prohibited outputs and measurable baseline before selecting a model.

activity.title: Define the decision boundary — applied workshop
activity.objective: O1: Map decision boundaries and evidence requirements for a synthetic reconciliation desk.
activity.overview: You support a synthetic reconciliation desk. Draw an input-to-review map with two mandatory human checkpoints.

steps.title: Concept setup · 10 minutes
steps.text: An assistant can suggest an action without permission to perform it. Name the decision owner, allowed inputs, prohibited outputs and measurable baseline before selecting a model.

steps.title: Implementation · 20 minutes
steps.text: Map each ID to review if confidence is missing or below 0.8, otherwise ready_for_review. Neither route executes an action. Open the starter notebook or visual workflow simulator.

steps.title: Task · 20 minutes
steps.text: Draw an input-to-review map with two mandatory human checkpoints. Record a normal, missing-input and human-review case.

steps.title: Research and discussion · 15 minutes
steps.text: Compare with a peer, cite your reading and identify a failure condition.

steps.title: Wrap-up · 5 minutes
steps.text: Explain why a simulation is not a production-ready system; name the accountable owner.

reflection: What evidence changes your decision?

capstonePackage.exemplar: A fictional approval queue retains missing scores, routes uncertainty to review and never executes updates. Its evidence pack records input versions, thresholds, subgroup counts, failed cases and a rollback owner. Adapt this scaffold to the program brief. This is not a finished capstone solution.
capstonePackage.peerReview: A peer challenges an unsupported claim and repeats one test; the author documents the response.
capstonePackage.status: Draft brief; finished program-specific exemplars require SME authoring.

evaluationPlan.pre: Explain a bounded workflow before instruction and attempt the first practice pool.
evaluationPlan.post: Use unseen synthetic cases and compare outcome-aligned rubric scores.
evaluationPlan.analytics: Local practice attempts and module checkpoints, not official grades.

transferPolicy: No automatic credit. Map outcomes and assessed evidence; an educator approves equivalence and prevents duplicate credit. Dependencies #1–#14 remain TBC.
